001package net.tnemc.paper;
002
003import net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperCalculationsProvider;
004import net.tnemc.item.paper.PaperItemStack;
005import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
006import org.bukkit.block.ShulkerBox;
007import org.bukkit.inventory.Inventory;
008import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
009import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.BlockStateMeta;
010import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.BundleMeta;
011import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta;
012
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.Collection;
015import java.util.Iterator;
016import java.util.Objects;
017import java.util.function.Function;
018
019public final class PaperInventoryCalculations extends PaperCalculationsProvider {
020
021  @Override
022  public int removeAll(final PaperItemStack stack, final Inventory inventory, final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
023
024    return edit(inventory, staged -> Integer.MAX_VALUE - remove(stack, staged, Integer.MAX_VALUE, useShulker, useBundles));
025  }
026
027  @Override
028  public int removeItem(final PaperItemStack stack, final Inventory inventory, final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
029
030    return edit(inventory, staged -> remove(stack, staged, stack.amount(), useShulker, useBundles));
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  public void takeItems(final Collection<PaperItemStack> items, final Inventory inventory,
035                        final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
036
037    edit(inventory, staged -> {
038      items.forEach(item -> remove(item, staged, item.amount(), useShulker, useBundles));
039      return null;
040    });
041  }
042
043  @Override
044  public Collection<PaperItemStack> giveItems(final Collection<PaperItemStack> items, final Inventory inventory,
045                                             final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
046
047    return edit(inventory, staged -> giveNative(items, staged));
048  }
049
050  private Collection<PaperItemStack> giveNative(final Collection<PaperItemStack> items, final Inventory inventory) {
051
052    final Collection<PaperItemStack> remaining = new ArrayList<>();
053    for(final PaperItemStack item : items) {
054      if(item == null || item.amount() == 0) {
055        continue;
056      }
057      if(item.amount() < 0) {
058        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot give a negative item amount");
059      }
060      final ItemStack nativeItem = Objects.requireNonNull(item.provider().locale(item, item.amount()),
061                                                         "Item provider returned no item").clone();
062      if(nativeItem.getType().isAir()) {
063        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Item provider returned an empty item");
064      }
065      nativeItem.setAmount(item.amount());
066      // Inventory.addItem returns the actual remaining stacks. Keep their complete native
067      // identity instead of sending them through TNIL's partial component serializers again.
068      inventory.addItem(nativeItem).values().forEach(left -> remaining.add(new PaperItemSnapshot(left)));
069    }
070    return remaining;
071  }
072
073  private int remove(final PaperItemStack currency, final Inventory inventory, final int amount,
074                     final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
075
076    if(amount < 0) {
077      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot remove a negative item amount");
078    }
079    int remaining = amount;
080    final int storageSize = inventory.getStorageContents().length;
081    for(int slot = 0; slot < storageSize && remaining > 0; slot++) {
082      final ItemStack item = inventory.getItem(slot);
083      if(item == null || item.getType().isAir()) {
084        continue;
085      }
086      if(currency.provider().similar(currency, item)) {
087        final int removed = Math.min(remaining, item.getAmount());
088        remaining -= removed;
089        item.setAmount(item.getAmount() - removed);
090        inventory.setItem(slot, item.getAmount() == 0 ? null : item);
091        continue;
092      }
093      remaining = removeContents(currency, item, remaining, useShulker, useBundles);
094      inventory.setItem(slot, item);
095    }
096    return remaining;
097  }
098
099  private int removeContents(final PaperItemStack currency, final ItemStack item, final int amount,
100                             final boolean useShulker, final boolean useBundles) {
101
102    int remaining = amount;
103    final ItemMeta meta = item.getItemMeta();
104    if(useShulker && meta instanceof BlockStateMeta block && block.getBlockState() instanceof ShulkerBox shulker) {
105      remaining = remove(currency, shulker.getInventory(), remaining, false, false);
106      if(remaining != amount) {
107        block.setBlockState(shulker);
108        item.setItemMeta(block);
109      }
110    }
111    if(useBundles && meta instanceof BundleMeta bundle) {
112      remaining = removeBundle(currency, bundle, remaining);
113      if(remaining != amount) {
114        item.setItemMeta(bundle);
115      }
116    }
117    return remaining;
118  }
119
120  private int removeBundle(final PaperItemStack currency, final BundleMeta bundle, final int amount) {
121
122    int remaining = amount;
123    final ArrayList<ItemStack> contents = new ArrayList<>(bundle.getItems());
124    final Iterator<ItemStack> iterator = contents.iterator();
125    while(iterator.hasNext() && remaining > 0) {
126      final ItemStack item = iterator.next();
127      if(currency.provider().similar(currency, item)) {
128        final int removed = Math.min(remaining, item.getAmount());
129        remaining -= removed;
130        if(removed == item.getAmount()) {
131          iterator.remove();
132        } else {
133          item.setAmount(item.getAmount() - removed);
134        }
135      }
136    }
137    bundle.setItems(contents);
138    return remaining;
139  }
140
141  private <Result> Result edit(final Inventory inventory, final Function<Inventory, Result> operation) {
142
143    final ItemStack[] contents = inventory.getStorageContents();
144    final Inventory staged = contents.length % 9 == 0 ? Bukkit.createInventory(null, contents.length)
145                                                     : Bukkit.createInventory(null, inventory.getType());
146    if(staged.getStorageContents().length != contents.length) {
147      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported inventory storage layout: " + inventory.getType());
148    }
149    staged.setMaxStackSize(inventory.getMaxStackSize());
150    for(int slot = 0; slot < contents.length; slot++) {
151      if(contents[slot] != null) {
152        staged.setItem(slot, contents[slot].clone());
153      }
154    }
155    final Result result = operation.apply(staged);
156    inventory.setStorageContents(staged.getStorageContents());
157    return result;
158  }
159}
